courses.mapping_gap: The official doctoral admission page confirms the Ph.D. programme but the current central catalogue does not enumerate one complete active subject list for a responsible discipline mapping.

agent_notes: The exact institution name and Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh location were confirmed in all four supplied NIRF 2025 government directory pages.
The official homepage and About University page clearly establish the Jaunpur campus identity.
The current official PUCAT-2026 brochure provides a detailed 2026-27 campus catalogue with programme names and durations. The official admissions page also lists current M.Ed. and B.P.Ed. admissions.

The website is classified as partial because its general faculty/degree pages refer to broader offerings, affiliated-college material and doctoral research, but no single current comprehensive catalogue of all active university programmes and doctoral subject offerings was established.
D.Litt./D.Sc. material was not imported as an active programme because the official page exposes an older 2023 ordinance/notification rather than a current active admission catalogue entry.
Eligibility fields remain null because the current central catalogue does not explicitly state programme-specific eligibility in the catalogue table.

Normal TLS verification failed with the exact local proxy self-signed-certificate-chain error for the expected NIRF and VBSPU hosts; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to those confirmed government/official hosts.
